mapper.select: SELECT id, category_id, name, subtitle, image_path, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at FROM mall_product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, category_id, name, subtitle, image_path, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at FROM mall_product WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, category_id, name, subtitle, image_path, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at FROM mall_product WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.name, p.subtitle, p.image_path AS image_url, p.status, COUNT(s.id) AS sku_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.stock), 0) AS total_stock, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM mall_product p INNER JOIN product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.category_id, c.name, p.name, p.subtitle, p.image_path, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT p.id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.name, p.subtitle, p.image_path AS image_url, p.status, COUNT(s.id) AS sku_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.stock), 0) AS total_stock, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM mall_product p INNER JOIN product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{id} GROUP BY p.id, p.category_id, c.name, p.name, p.subtitle, p.image_path, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_product (category_id, name, subtitle, image_path, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{subtitle}, #{imagePath}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, image_path = #{imagePath}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
